_doc: Canonical MCP server list. scripts/sync.sh mirrors this to .mcp.json (Claude Code), opencode.json (OpenCode), and .agents/mcp_config.json (Antigravity workspace). Secrets stay in env — reference with ${VAR}, never paste values. Keep 3-5 servers max: every server eats context.

convex._when: Convex projects — schema/data introspection while coding. Delete if not using Convex.

github._when: PR/issue ops from chat during integration. Export GITHUB_PAT in your shell first.
